title: Death Duel VR
description:
Вышло обновлениеDeath Duel VR 2.0 – Duelists Redemption is here.
This major update overhauls the game's core systems and introduces five new game modes for up to 4 players. Core Combat Improvements: • Netcode Overhaul: A complete networking rebuild ensures smooth, stable, and perfectly synchronized battles.

 

• Reforged Weapon Mechanics: Weapons now follow clear rules of leverage and timing. Precision is rewarded, while poor form is punished.

 

• New Damage System: Strikes now calculate damage based on precision, edge alignment, and timing.

 

• Redesigned HUD: A new UI clearly displays limb/torso/head health, as well as block and guard quality.

 

• Weight Rating System: Each weapon now has a distinct identity, from fast light blades to momentum-based heavy weapons.

 New 4-Player Game Modes: • Bootcamp: A cooperative training ground to learn with friends.

 

• 1 on 1: Refined duels in a party-style room.

 

• Team Deathmatch: Fight with shared lives, coordinated tactics, and a live scoreboard.

 

• Warlord: One armored juggernaut versus the entire lobby.

 

• Free-For-All: Total chaotic combat to prove you're the deadliest.

Об игреFree To Play: Taste Core PvP! Experience core PvP combat in the Free To Play version. Fight full-version players in limited combat. Unlock ALL weapons, armors, modes & progression with the Elite Package (FULL GAME). 

 

Hello Duelist’s, This is Community Manager Tyrus Rechs. It has come to my attention that not a lot of people know about our discord server.

We primarily engage with the community over discord.gg as it's easier to manage discussions over there.

You may also find people to fight with in the Looking-for-game chat by @ the role that notify people to you willingness to fight.

What is Death Duel VRExperience Historically Accurate VR Duels, Powered by Physics. Death Duel VR is a competitive online melee combat simulator. 

Master authentic HEMA techniques – real guards, strikes, and grappling – against live opponents in physics-driven PvP.

Wield swords, shields, polearms, flails, and more with realistic collision and leverage. 

Engage in intense foot combat or test your skill in mounted jousting.

Step into the medieval tournament arena, recreated for VR controllers. Duel with history, duel with skill.

Key features: 

Fencing with sword, shield, flail, polearm and etc. 
Jousting

 

Is there single player Content? 
Absolutely! Experience the "Way of the Duelist" roguelike campaign from Elite Package DLC. Hone your techniques solo, collect XP and credits through challenging runs, and unlock legendary weapons to wield in PvE. 

 

To report bugs please post them on Discord where I answer questions most of time.
description_short: Experience True HEMA Combat in VR. Step beyond button mashing. Death Duel VR uses physics-based leverage to let you authentically execute historical European martial arts techniques against live opponents. Master real guards, leverage, and tactics in heart-pounding PvP duels to the death.
